text: semantic_text fields auto-generate vector embeddings via a configured ML model on indexing
quote: When you index content into a `semantic_text` field, Elasticsearch automatically generates vector embeddings using a configured machine learning model and stores them in the underlying vector field.

text: Hybrid search runs full-text and vector search together in a single request
quote: Hybrid search runs full-text search and vector search in one request.

text: Recommends reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) to merge full-text and vector rankings for hybrid search
quote: We recommend implementing hybrid search with the reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) algorithm.

text: One engine combines vector search, full-text search, structured filters, aggregations, and hybrid retrieval
quote: Elasticsearch can combine vector search with full-text search, structured filters, aggregations, and hybrid retrieval in one engine

text: Single shell command spins up a local Elasticsearch (and Kibana) instance for quickstart use
quote: curl -fsSL https://elastic.co/start-local | sh

text: Wide range of official client libraries and developer tools across popular programming languages
quote: Elasticsearch is easy to use from most popular programming languages, thanks to the wide range of official libraries and developer tools available.

text: Elastic Cloud Serverless auto-provisions, manages, and scales resources based on actual usage
quote: Elastic Cloud Serverless automatically provisions, manages, and scales your Elasticsearch resources based on your actual usage.

text: New users can sign up for a free 14-day trial to create a serverless project
quote: If you are a new user, sign up for a free 14-day trial to create a serverless project.

text: An inference API workflow gives finer control over configuring the embedding/inference endpoint
quote: The inference API workflow is more complex but offers greater control over the inference endpoint configuration.

text: Official 'skills' packages teach AI coding agents how to work with Elasticsearch, Kibana, Fleet and the Elastic stack
quote: Install official skills that teach AI coding agents how to work with Elasticsearch, Kibana, Fleet, and the rest of the Elastic stack.

text: Supports deploying external/hosted embedding models or bringing your own pre-computed vectors
quote: You can deploy external or hosted embedding models, or bring your own pre-computed vectors.

text: Offers multiple self-managed and Elastic-managed deployment options
quote: Elastic provides several self-managed and Elastic-managed options.

text: Cross-project search unifies visibility across isolated projects without moving or duplicating data
quote: Unify global visibility without paying to move or duplicate your data.

text: Supports building RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) systems on top of indexed data
quote: RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) systems

text: Functions as a vector database by storing embeddings in dense_vector or sparse_vector fields for similarity queries
quote: Elasticsearch functions as a vector database when you store embeddings in `dense_vector` or `sparse_vector` fields and query them for similarity.

text: Improves vector quantization calibration speed during index merge operations
quote: Speed up vector quantization calibration during index merge

text: Creating an index mapping alone enables ingesting, embedding, and querying without separate inference pipeline setup
quote: All you need to do is create an index mapping to start ingesting, embedding, and querying data. There is no need to define model-related settings and parameters, or to create inference ingest pipelines.

text: Search and index tiers can be scaled independently with hardware optimized per workload
quote: Separating search and index tiers enables workloads to be scaled independently and reliably, with optimized hardware for each use case.

text: Provides an official MCP server for Elasticsearch to connect AI agents
quote: elastic / mcp-server-elasticsearch Public

text: Audit events can now include raw request bodies for protobuf-based requests
quote: Add `request.raw_body` to audit events for protobuf request bodies

text: Autoscaling automatically allocates extra resources during short-term ingest spikes and scales back down afterward
quote: when you have a short-term spike on the data you ingest, more resources are allocated for that period of time. When the spike is over, the system uses less resources, without any action on your end.
